name: Storm Giant Tradition Upbringing

benefits.name: Giant Language
benefits.description: Learn Giant through this cultural tradition.

benefits.name: Cultural Craft
benefits.description: Choose training in one Competency associated with this tradition: Navigation, Cartography.

benefits.name: Cultural Field Knowledge
benefits.description: Gain +2 on Nature checks for these learned activities: observable weather pattern analysis, natural storm patterns, tidal condition knowledge. The activity, not merely the character's location or ancestry, must qualify.

reviewNotes: Source inspiration: Navigation, sea and sky knowledge, and interpreting weather; the specific Skill and Competency grants are experimental Dorks & Dice adaptations, not published Upbringing statistics.
The upbringing is independently selectable by any Species, including non-Goliaths; it does not require a matching giant ancestry.
Giant culture does not require Gol-Kaa or general Goliath clan training, so this is not a child of upbringing.goliath.general.
No Giant Foundling, Rune Carver, rune spellcasting, Origin feat, Strike of the Giants, giant attack ability, or compulsory Ordning status is granted.
